title: Peru's Presidential Election: A Narrow Victory for Keiko Fujimori
summary: Keiko Fujimori has been declared the winner of Peru's presidential election after a narrow victory over her left-wing rival Roberto Sanchez. The election was marked by concerns over crime, with surging rates contributing to the outcome. Fujimori's pledge to restore 'order and hope' has raised questions about her plans for addressing these issues.
summary_points: Keiko Fujimori declared winner of Peru's presidential election
Narrow victory over left-wing rival Roberto Sanchez
Election marked by concerns over crime
Fujimori pledges to restore 'order and hope'
Surging crime rates contributed to the outcome
